note: .gitignore:2-25 ignores data/* wholesale and then re-includes, by name, the handful of files the pipeline treats as durable repository state. That make-it-explicit pattern is the opposite of what happened under reports/, where line 27 ignores exactly one directory and nothing else (F-02). It is the model the fix should follow.
